messages.text:
"Create a completely NEW mobile-only fantasy MMORPG called AETHERIA from scratch.

GRAPHICS: Use beautiful, detailed true 3D graphics with a fixed isometric camera angled diagonally from above. The camera follows the player without rotating or changing distance. Optimize everything for smartphones.

CHARACTER CREATION: Players choose male or female, enter their own unique character name, select a faction (Angels or Demons) and one of three classes:

- Warrior: strong melee fighter.
- Mage: powerful magic and ranged attacks.
- Assassin: fast attacks and critical damage.

Include hairstyles, hair colors, eye colors, three starting outfits and an interactive 3D character preview. Angels have celestial wings, Demons have demonic wings.

WORLD: Create eight regions: Greendale, Ironcrag, Venomwood, Mistgrave, Frostpeak, Sunscorch Desert, Ashen Dominion and Tower of Eternity. Include Dawnshire, Stonewatch, Sunmarket and Frosthaven. Use large separate maps with loading transitions.

GAMEPLAY: Real-time combat, normal attacks, class skills, auto-attack, HP/MP, potions, experience, leveling, respawning monsters, rare monsters, world events, quests, dungeons and bosses. Each class has unique weapons, armor and a main skill upgradeable to level 10.

EQUIPMENT AND LOOT: Include 9 equipment slots, class and level restrictions and four direct drop rarities: Common 60%, Grey 25%, Green 10%, Blue 5%. All direct drops are T3. Purple and higher never drop directly.

FUSION AND CRAFTING: Combine 4 identical items: T3 to T2, T2 to T1, T1 to next rarity T3. No random item destruction. Craft Legendary using rare materials, recipes and boss drops. Four Legendary create Mythic; four Mythic create Divine. Mythic and Divine never drop directly. Boss stones have up to 3 bonuses. Critical chance is capped at 50%.

ECONOMY: Include gathering, crafting, materials, recipes, blacksmiths, merchants, storage, Gold, Gems and a player marketplace. Configurable prices for crafting, fusion, potions and teleportation. No repair system.

QUESTS AND NPCS: Main and side quests, rewards and interactive NPCs. Starting village includes blacksmith, merchant, quest NPC, storage NPC and teleporter.

SHOP: Costumes, hairstyles, mounts, pets, weapon effects, faction wings, Gems and optional premium membership. Wings are quest or shop rewards only, never monster drops, never tradeable or fusible. Gems must also be earnable through gameplay. Keep everything free-to-play without mandatory purchases.

MOBILE UI: Virtual joystick, attack and skill buttons, interaction, mount, auto-attack, HP/MP bars, minimap, inventory, equipment, quests, shop and character profile. All game text and UI must be in English.

DEVELOPMENT – TWO PHASES:

Phase 1: Build character creation, 3D preview, factions, classes, fixed 3D camera, mobile controls, starting village, first region, combat, monsters, skills, inventory, equipment, drops and basic quests.

Phase 2: Expand with all remaining regions, monsters, crafting, full fusion, marketplace, economy, dungeons, bosses, shop, mounts, pets, wings and world events.

Prepare the architecture for real online multiplayer, accounts, persistent data and secure server-authoritative gameplay. Never pretend local simulation is real multiplayer.

Build a real playable mobile game, not a mockup. Use modular code, optimize for smartphones, test all features and fix errors. Preserve working systems when expanding the game. (3D Game, Phone/Tablet)

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
